accountHint: Your identity, authorized integrations and password.
adminHint: Review registrations and manage account access.
libraryHint: A home for each subject — lectures, Markdown and illustrations.
signInHint: Username: 3–32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Password: 12–128 characters.
pending: Registration received. An administrator must approve your account before you can sign in.
error: Operation failed. Check your input and access, then try again. Unsaved text is preserved.
claimHint: This existing-key session owns the original workspace. Bind an administrator username and password once; old content stays in place.
claimed: Administrator bound. Sign out and sign in with your new account.
tokenHint: No server model needed. Choose 30, 90, 365 days or no expiry. Credentials belong only to your workspace and can be revoked. Keep them in private local files, not prompts or source code.
readWarning: Both scopes can create, update and delete; write responses may include the affected object. Read and write additionally permits downloading all workspace content and revision history.
once: Copy this credential now. It is shown only once. Do not share it.
bindFirst: Sign in with a username/password account to manage credentials.
passwordHint: Changing your password signs out all account sessions and revokes all integration credentials.
title: Title
imageHint: PNG / JPEG / WebP, no file-size cap. Available storage still applies. Images remain private and are included in database backups.
pdfHint: Uses your browser’s print dialog. Choose Save as PDF; wait for images and formulas to load first.
spaceHint: Create a subject such as Quantum Field Theory or Statistical Physics. Each space has its own lecture collection.
recoverHint: Deleted content is retained. Restore its space before opening a lecture.
apiExample: Use Authorization: Bearer <credential> and a unique Idempotency-Key for each mutation. Retry uncertain requests with the same key; send the current entity version on updates.
changeSuccess: Password changed. Please sign in again.
